shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated motifs (rosette row in A, row of rectangles/arches in B)
stacked/registered organisation of the carved surface
raised flat-topped relief with plain background field
justification: Both are shallow relief on a large stone surface, with profile figures set against a plain ground and a horizontal band of repeated units running across the field, which is the most specific correspondence. Beyond that they diverge sharply: A is a single continuous frieze of naturalistically modelled, richly detailed human figures in procession, while B is a schematic, boldly outlined array of animals and abstract signs distributed over the irregular faces of a free-standing pillar without a shared groundline or processional order.
